h1: Increment in Scrum: Definition, Rules and Examples
seo_title: Increment in Scrum: Definition, Rules and Examples
meta_description: What an Increment is in Scrum: the 2020 Scrum Guide rules, the Definition of Done, Increment vs release, examples, a worked undone-work example and mistakes.
excerpt: The Scrum Increment explained: what the 2020 Scrum Guide requires, five properties with test questions, Increment vs release and MVP, how the wording changed from 2017, examples, multi-team Increments and a worked undone-work calculation.
learning_objectives: Define the Scrum Increment and its commitment, the Definition of Done, as the 2020 Scrum Guide states them
Test work against five properties of an Increment
Distinguish an Increment from a release, deliverable, MVP, Sprint and SAFe Planning Interval
Explain how the 2017 and 2020 Scrum Guide wording differs
Quantify undone work and compare it with bringing the work inside the Definition of Done
Respond to a Sprint that produces no Increment
